verdict.rationale: Funnel analytics is a fair axis for an identity-verification platform, but nothing in the evidence shows pass rates, drop-off points, or completion times broken down by country or document type. The only analytics mentioned are the operations-focused metrics in Cases (SLAs, case resolution rates), which do not cover the signup funnel. Webhooks and API status polling expose raw inquiry events that a team could build its own analytics from, but that is not a delivered funnel-analytics capability.
